All row counts cross-checked: category.product_count and the live products.total_count matched exactly for every id (batched GraphQL query). Storage (24) + Tables & Desks (13) = 37, slightly over the New In parent's 34 - a small (3-unit) overlap between the two sub-listings, not an error. No other new-arrivals-type nodes found anywhere in the 1120-node tree; the 'Newham Range' nodes that matched the loose keyword scan are a product-line/brand name (contains 'new-') and not a New Arrivals listing, confirmed by name and excluded.
